src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (Male & Female) in AP

x: A good test must have all three: validity (measures what it claims), reliability (consistent results) and objectivity (scoring free of examiner bias).

s: The following is a measure of reliability obtained by administering the same test twice over a period of time to a group of individuals.
x: Test-retest reliability = giving the same test to the same group twice over a time gap and correlating the scores; parallel forms use two equivalent tests, split-half divides one test.

src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (Male & Female) in AP

x: Guthrie's contiguity theory holds that forgetting comes not from disuse but from interference by new learning (new responses replace old ones).

src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (Male & Female) in AP
s: Which one is the highest order of learning?
x: In Gagne's hierarchy of learning, problem-solving is the highest type; signal (conditioned-reflex) and stimulus-response learning are the lowest, with chaining in between.

src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (Male & Female) in AP
s: According to Psychologists, what is 'plateau' in learning process?
o: An indication of fatigue and boredom to give a gap in our trail for learning
The final stage of learning indicating the further attempts will lead to frustration
A Stage when the learner is consolidating his previous learning and preparing for further learning
A stage at which an individual faces some difficulty in progressing further
x: A plateau is a period of no visible progress in the learning curve; psychologists explain it as a stage when the learner consolidates earlier learning and prepares for further gains – not the final stage.

src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (Male & Female) in AP
s: Teachers typically administer the following test for reading and math skills and using that results try to provide remedial instruction or place students within appropriately leveled classes.
x: A diagnostic test finds a pupil's specific weaknesses so that remedial teaching or level placement can follow; achievement tests measure what was learnt.

src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (Male & Female) in AP

src: Miscellaneous Exams
s:

src: APPSC Group-1 PYQ

The ability to monitor one's own and others ' feelings and one's thinking and actions
The ability to avoid emotional responses in decision-making

src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (Male & Female) in AP

src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (Male & Female) in AP
s: Counseling based on learning theories and principles is known as

src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (Male & Female) in AP

src: APPSC Group-1 PYQ
